articles.summary: TaskUs paid tribute to Cali as the “Salsa Capital of the World” with its very own float at the Salsódromo parade on December 25. With the theme Alegría que Inspira (Joy That Inspires), the Feria de Cali showcased the passion, creativity, and salsa heritage of the city. The event, which ran from December 25 to 30, featured live concerts, parades, fashion shows, fireworks, and plenty of dancing.
